shots.text: Dirt. That's the first thing I felt.
shots.note: Macro on dirt grains. Rack focus reveals 250's head lying in the dirt, eyes closed.

shots.text: Cold dirt on my face, and a heartbeat that wasn't slowing down.
shots.note: Extreme close-up of his head on the dirt. Heartbeat; his eye slowly opens.

shots.text: I tried to move my legs, and all six answered at once, too fast, like they belonged to someone else.
shots.note: Still lying down, all six legs kick at once, far too fast.

shots.text: They told me later I was gone for two days.
shots.note: Wide: 250 lying still as sisters walk past. Light rises and falls (time passing).
Cold, desaturated close shot of his motionless body.
His eye snaps open, green glint; hyper senses begin.

shots.text: a beetle digging three tunnels over,
shots.note: A beetle glowing as an outline, digging three tunnels away.

shots.text: a drop of water about to fall,
shots.note: Slow motion: a drop swelling on a root tip.

shots.text: the queen breathing somewhere deep below.
shots.note: Far below, the queen's outline, slowly breathing.

shots.text: I could smell fear in the walls, old fear, from ants who'd died here long before me.
shots.note: Faint outlines of long-dead ants inside the dirt walls.

shots.text: My jaws twitched open, then {snap}snapped shut so fast the air cracked.
shots.note: Close-up: the mandibles twitch, then SNAP.
He stares; the jaws slowly cock open again.
250 pushes up off the dirt; mandibles cock open.
Among identical sisters; only a tiny green glint gives him away.

shots.text: And before this... I was nobody.
shots.note: Pull back: endless tunnels; 250 is a speck.
